thread:
incident-bot: [PAGER] streaming p99 latency > 6s for 6m across multiple decode shards. Observed surge in KV cache paging and eviction churn. Pager: @sam
sam: Im oncall, looking at the traces. p95 currently 900ms, p99 ~6.2s. Streaming stall traces show decode workers waiting on disk I/O. tagging @jo for runtime handoff.
jo: on it. any customer hits?
cs-ara: two enterprise customers flagged slow interactive sessions: LedgerGrid + FormsHQ. they opened support tickets ~2m ago.
mira: metrics: eviction_rate spiked x5 on shard-7 and shard-8. fragment_count increased; avg object size dropped which suggests lots of tiny prefill writes. prefill write rate jumped.
ops-lee: logs from prefill-producer show numerous small writes and retries: `WARN prefill: write partial success, retrying 127 entries` and high concurrency.
sam: hypothesis: prefill concurrency caused many small entries, causing fragmentation -> frequent evictions -> decode workers hitting disk/pager. Looks like prefill vs decode imbalance.
jo: confirm: decode-worker-7 shows high page_faults/sec and large swap activity. also see many short-lived KV keys with TTLs that cause churn.
sam: mitigation plan (immediate): 1) reduce prefill write concurrency to limit churn; 2) route 30% of streaming traffic away from affected shards to decode-stable variant; 3) bump cache_coalesce_window to coalesce small prefill writes where possible.
mira: I can flip prefill concurrency env var in k8s. command:```kubectl -n platform set env deploy/prefill-producer PREFILL_CONCURRENCY=10```
ops-lee: applying route rule to divert 30% of stream traffic from shard-7/8 to decode-stable in region eu-central. will monitor for error delta.
infra-bot: cache_coalesce_window config updated to 200ms on prefill-producer for a quick experiment. note: this may add tail to first-token latency for new sessions.
cs-ara: notifying customers with a brief message: "were aware of slow sessions, mitigating now; will follow up with timeline."
sam: executing throttle now. PREFILL_CONCURRENCY 40 -> 10. infra shows prefill Q depth dropping. eviction_rate down ~60% within 90s.
jo: p99 dropped from 6.2s -> 1.4s after routing and throttle. p95 now ~350ms. paging_iops down 68%. tail stalls remain but confined to shard-7 tail.
mira: digging into profiles. running heap/profile: `/diag/profile --target decode-worker-7 --duration 45s --type heap,alloc`
ops-lee: profile uploaded: /artifacts/4067891234/decode7_profile.tar.gz. initial flame shows heavy allocation in prefill serialization path and many tiny buffer allocations.
sam: declaring incident P1 due to sustained p99 breach and customer impact. owners: sam (lead), jo (runtime), mira (metrics/mitigation), ops-lee (routing/infra), cs-ara (customer comms).
product-zoe: note: decode-stable variant reduces KV prefetch depth by 40% and may alter prompt tokenization slightly; ok for short-term fallback?
jo: yes, safe for 1-2 hours. keeping canary at 30%.
ops-lee: starting a rolling restart on decode-worker-7 to free fragmented memory. will drain then restart single node.
mira: after restart and throttle, p99 ~1.1s and p95 ~300ms. eviction_rate back to baseline in 6m window.
cs-ara: customers acknowledged mitigation; one requested a short post-incident note.
sam: next immediate tasks: 1) collect last 40m of KV metrics and prefill write traces (mira), 2) followup RFC to add prefill batching/coalescing long-term (product-zoe + runtime), 3) consider automatic route diversion when eviction_rate > 3x baseline (ops-lee).
jo: adding runbook step to detect prefill/decode imbalance: alert if prefill_write_rate / decode_consumption_rate > 1.5 and eviction_rate > 2x baseline.
infra-bot: sanity check: memory utilization increased ~12% on affected nodes after coalesce window change; monitoring.
sam: leaving the live thread open for 30m observation. thanks everyone. I'll hand off ongoing analysis to jo + mira.
jo: handing over for postmortem. collecting profiles and timeline. will link artifacts at /artifacts/4067891234/pm/
incident-bot: [UPDATE] mitigations applied: prefill throttle, route diversion to decode-stable, coalesce window increase. Monitoring for 30 mins.
cs-ara: sent customer follow-up with remediation steps and expected timeline for permanent fix.
product-zoe: will prioritize prefill batching RFC in next sprint.
mira: creating the incident timeline and graphs (p95/p99, eviction_rate, paging_iops, mem_used).
sam: closing live coordination. leaving P1 active for postmortem. :thumbsup:
